description: Part C (PRD 4 §4.1.4 + PRD 1 §5.4, POSEIDON variant post Lever-1; DIGEST form amended 2026-07-05): t_root from ordered proof_tool_calls rows (sorted by call_index ASC). record_bytes_i = 0x20 || tool_id_digest(32B = SHA-256(tool_id_utf8)) || args_hash(32B) || result_hash(32B) || ts(8B BE u64, microseconds) || sats(8B BE u64) = fixed 113 B. leaf_i = poseidon_leaf_hash(record_to_field(record_bytes_i)) over Pallas-Fq (neptune 13.0.0, param artifact 4aeda63c...). Tree uses poseidon internal_hash; Z = poseidon_leaf_hash(record_to_field(empty)). t_root = poseidon_internal_hash(length_element(0x03,|T_log|), tree_root_top). Regenerated 2026-07-09 for the 113-B digest form. The leaf_hashes/t_root here are recomputed by konareef's Go poseidon impl and pinned by conformance_test.go (self-consistency over these tool_a/b/c rows) — regenerate them from the independent oracle (paygate-zk troot_poseidon.rs Rust goldens) when the encoding changes. The record ENCODING itself (encode_record) is independently cross-validated byte-exact vs paygate-zk's konareef_circuit via a live PS-1 t_root match (internal/feeder TestPS1SmokeVoiceForgeWithTools, over a different 2-record fixture, KONAREEF_PS1_SMOKE_URL-gated).
